Hi Maya — welcome, and thanks for the spec.

Quick answers up front:
- Technical gating: we need a light integration that (a) uses our public inference API (no private keys embedded), (b) supports token-level telemetry only (no customer PII), and (c) has a validated auth flow for customer entitlements.
- Co-sell evidence: we require metering proof (sample invoices or telemetry showing calls), an entitlement mapping doc, and a mutually-signed MAA (mutual action plan).

I've attached our Redwood partner checklist to illustrate the template of evidence we expect. Olga, can you review the adapter for any security flags? Ben, adding you for marketplace packaging and SKU mapping.

If that works, propose a 30m technical sync Thursday 10/08 10:00-10:30 PT. I’ll send calendar when people confirm.

Thanks,

Hi all — quick technical triage notes from security & integrations: 

- Auth: customer-authorized API key is fine for the adapter provided keys are not stored in plaintext and adapter rotates keys per customer. We prefer OAuth-based token exchange; if you can do that, it removes a few gating items.
- Data: Telemetry must be scoped to token/usage metadata only — no raw request/response payload captured. Please add a text snippet in your adapter docs showing which fields are transmitted.
- Metering evidence: a 2-week signed CSV export + a small integration test (we run a sample workload and verify counters) will be acceptable for initial co-sell approval.

Ben: on SKU naming, recommend pattern RDW-<partner>-<tier> (e.g., RDW-TELEMETRYAI-PRO) so our billing + telemetry plumbing can align. Vivek, can you confirm metering ingestion windows & billing reconciliation SLA?

Olga Petrov
Head of Integrations, Redwood Inference
